WITH donor_counts AS (
  SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS donation_count
  FROM "donations"
  GROUP BY "Donor"
),
repeat_givers AS (
  SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor") AS count_repeat
  FROM "donations" d
  JOIN donor_counts dc ON d."Donor" = dc."Donor"
  WHERE dc.donation_count > 1
),
one_time_givers AS (
  SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount
  FROM "donations" d
  JOIN donor_counts dc ON d."Donor" = dc."Donor"
  WHERE dc.donation_count = 1
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * rg.total_amount / NULLIF(rg.total_amount + otg.total_amount, 0)) AS share_percent,
  rg.count_repeat
FROM repeat_givers rg
CROSS JOIN one_time_givers otg;

WITH donor_counts AS (
  SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS donation_count
  FROM "donations"
  GROUP BY "Donor"
),
repeat_donors AS (
  SELECT "Donor"
  FROM donor_counts
  WHERE donation_count > 1
),
one_time_donors AS (
  SELECT "Donor"
  FROM donor_counts
  WHERE donation_count = 1
),
repeat_amount AS (
  SELECT SUM(d."Amount") AS total_repeat_amount
  FROM "donations" d
  JOIN repeat_donors r ON d."Donor" = r."Donor"
),
one_time_amount AS (
  SELECT SUM(d."Amount") AS total_one_time_amount
  FROM "donations" d
  JOIN one_time_donors o ON d."Donor" = o."Donor"
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(ra.total_repeat_amount, 0) AS repeat_amount,
    COALESCE(ota.total_one_time_amount, 0) AS one_time_amount,
    COALESCE(ra.total_repeat_amount, 0) + COALESCE(ota.total_one_time_amount, 0) AS total_amount
  FROM repeat_amount ra
  CROSS JOIN one_time_amount ota
),
repeat_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM repeat_donors
)
SELECT 
  (t.repeat_amount * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_amount, 0)) AS share_percent,
  rc.cnt AS count_repeat_givers
FROM totals t
CROSS JOIN repeat_count rc;
